name: The Story of a Morning
source:
For the better part of 7 centuries, Avice has experienced the march of time in 24 hour increments. Bound to the tree that houses her best—and worst—memories, she wanders the New Keltberk Botanical Gardens each year on the anniversary of her death. Ignored by the living, she has grown used to isolation and prefers to avoid the touring crowds by hiding in the arboretum. 

This year, however, she quickly finds her solitary vigil interrupted by the impromptu appearance of a young clairvoyant. Airheaded and immature, Quinn is the very definition of a problem child. But what they lack in brain cells, they more than make up for in sheer obstinance. 

Can these two troubled souls overcome their differences and find peace? Or will their futures remain bound to chains of the past?   

[From [url=https://tryphena.itch.io/the-story-of-a-morning]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
近七个世纪以来，Avice只能以每次24小时的片段，感受时光的流逝。她被束缚在一棵承载着自己最美好、也最痛苦回忆的树旁，每年只在忌日那天徘徊于新Keltberk植物园。活人对她视而不见，她早已习惯孤独，更喜欢躲进树木园，避开成群的游客。

然而今年，一位年轻灵媒突然出现，很快打断了她独自度过忌日的平静。Quinn迷糊又幼稚，简直就是个标准的问题儿童。不过，脑子不够灵光的地方，全都被那股十足的倔劲补上了。

这两个饱受困扰的灵魂，能否放下分歧，寻得安宁？还是说，他们的未来仍将被过去的锁链牢牢束缚？

[摘自[url=https://tryphena.itch.io/the-story-of-a-morning]itch.io[/url]]
